content.text: If you're a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, and you can't use Gumroad or Stripe due to country restrictions, it's not just a temporary inconvenience – it's a permanent infrastructure problem. Your business depends on a platform that can reject your payment methods, freeze your funds, or even shut down your account entirely. It's time to switch to a sovereign commerce infrastructure that puts you in control, not a platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad, as a platform, offers a range of features for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe-what-nobody-tells-2|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-presets-without-stripe-explained-digital-creators-stripe|Selling Presets]]-pdf-guides-without-gumroad-explained-digital-creators|selling]] digital products, including customizable storefronts, product variations, and analytics. However, when it comes to restricted countries, Gumroad's limitations become apparent. You're forced to rely on third-party payment processors like PayPal or Stripe, which can be just as restrictive. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a comprehensive digital commerce solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is designed to operate independently of traditional payment processors, giving you full control over your business.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The big difference between Gumroad and Edge Commerce Stack is how they handle country restrictions. Gumroad relies on third-party payment processors, which can be shut down or restricted at any time. On the other hand, Edge Commerce Stack is a sovereign commerce infrastructure that operates independently of these restrictions. With Edge Commerce Stack, you can sell digital products to customers in restricted countries without relying on a platform that can be taken away from you.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, Gumroad's limitations become apparent. You're forced to rely on third-party payment processors, which can charge high fees and hold your funds for extended periods. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack uses NOWPayments, which offers faster payment processing and lower fees. You can also set up automated payment processing and delivery, eliminating the need for manual intervention.
Edge Commerce Stack operates independently of traditional payment processors, making it the perfect solution for entrepreneurs in restricted countries.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
NOWPayments offers faster payment processing and lower fees, making it the perfect payment processor for Edge Commerce Stack.

This stack is designed to operate independently of traditional payment processors and provides a range of features that make it the perfect solution for entrepreneurs. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our products.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy Edge Commerce Stack, follow these concrete steps: Deploy Stack 02 in 48 hours using Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure secure email delivery. Load 5 products onto the stack, ensuring that each product is properly configured for payment processing and delivery. Test the stack end-to-end to ensure that payment processing and delivery are working as expected. Provide 30-day support to ensure that any issues are resolved quickly and efficiently.

To set up automated payment processing with Edge Commerce Stack, simply configure your payment settings in the NOWPayments dashboard. This will allow you to automate payment processing and delivery, eliminating the need for manual intervention.

To ensure secure email delivery with Edge Commerce Stack, configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings in your stack's dashboard. This will help prevent email spoofing and ensure that your emails are delivered securely.
Can I customize my Edge Commerce Stack to meet my business needs?

Yes, Edge Commerce Stack is highly customizable, allowing you to tailor your stack to meet your business needs. You can configure payment settings, product variations, and analytics to suit your requirements.
What kind of support do I get with Edge Commerce Stack?
With Edge Commerce Stack, you get 30-day support to ensure that any issues are resolved quickly and efficiently.
